data.exact_reserve_text: During 2019 the Syndicate released $38.3m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2018: $47.0m), arising predominantly from the Marine, Energy and Property divisions (2018; primarily from the Treaty, Energy and Marine Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on prior year losses during 2019.

prior_year_events.event_name: Hurricanes Michael and Florence; Typhoons Jebi and Trami; Woolsey and Camp wildfires; Ituango hydroelectric dam losses
prior_year_events.impact_description: The Syndicate had exposure to a number of catastrophe events in 2018. The current estimated ultimate claims for these events are $270.9m gross and $82.4m net of reinsurance; after inwards and outwards reinstatement premiums this reduces to $81.8m. These 2018 events contributed to prior years' reserves and development.

named_events.event_name: Typhoons Faxai and Hagibis and hurricane Dorian
named_events.loss_description: The current estimated ultimate claims for these events are $193.2m gross and $89.0m net of reinsurance. After inwards and outwards reinstatement premiums, this reduces to $88.0m.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2019 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were $2,503.5m. During 2019 the Syndicate recorded a prior-year release of $38.3m, driven predominantly by favourable claims development in the Marine, Energy and Property divisions. The report also notes significant named catastrophe exposures for 2018 (e.g. hurricanes Michael and Florence, typhoons Jebi and Trami, California wildfires and the Ituango dam issue) and for 2019 (typhoons Faxai and Hagibis and hurricane Dorian) with aggregated estimated ultimate claims disclosed in the Technical Reserves note.

data.data_quality_notes: Amounts are reported in the report's presentation currency (USD). Opening gross claims outstanding and the prior-year movement are taken directly from the Technical Reserves note and Movement in prior year's provision note respectively. The claims development triangle is present in the report (page 26) but extraction of every cell was only partially performed; triangle-derived PYD was not used because an explicit prior-year movement figure ($38.3m release) is stated in the notes. Some named-event amounts are aggregated across multiple events and are reported as aggregated amounts in the notes.
